title: Problem
问题
html:
Real CAD datasets expose final geometry but rarely the editable construction history needed to train interpretable program-generating models.

Zero-to-CAD uses tool-using agents to synthesize, execute, repair, and validate nearly one million CadQuery construction programs without real trajectories. The decision boundary is whether a serialized training record survives isolated code execution, topology checks, geometric validation, and export validation; the central artifact is data consumed by CAD program generation SFT and agent training, not a model-only release.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2604.24479; arXiv preprint; data object Zero-to-CAD 1M with 999,633 executable CAD construction sequences; evaluation surface All 999,633 released sequences pass code-execution, geometric, and export validation; the paper evaluates generation validity and diversity rather than treating rendering alone as success.; collection note: full paper, official README, license, schema, and an actual public record checked on 2026-07-27.

真实 CAD 数据通常只有最终几何，缺少训练可解释程序生成模型所需的可编辑构造历史。

该方法让工具代理生成、执行、修复并验证构造程序，从零合成近百万条完整历史。 判定边界是记录能否通过隔离执行、拓扑检查、几何验证和导出验证并成为CAD 程序生成监督微调与代理训练的输入；中心产物是训练数据，而不是只发布模型。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2604.24479；来源状态为arXiv 预印本；数据对象是 Zero-to-CAD 1M，规模为999633 条可执行 CAD 构造序列；评估锚点为公开的 999633 条序列全部通过代码执行、几何和导出三层验证；论文另外评估生成有效性与多样性。；已于 2026-07-27 阅读全文、官方说明、许可、字段和一条公开实际记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Zero-to-CAD uses tool-using agents to synthesize, execute, repair, and validate nearly one million CadQuery construction programs without real trajectories. Relative to geometry-only CAD corpora and small executable-code datasets, it makes uuid, CadQuery file, topology counts, operation sequence, latencies, eight renders, STL, and STEP files the reusable target and uses isolated code execution, topology checks, geometric validation, and export validation as the feedback contract, so Track 01 is the correct category.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: an LLM-sampled catalog of mechanical-part descriptions without real construction histories. Operation: Normalize prompts, media, provenance, and reference fields into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject missing task inputs, source identifiers, or access terms.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: Each normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: tool-using agents generate CadQuery code, inspect errors, consult documentation, and repair candidates. Output and transition: A serialized response, reasoning trace, or tool trajectory advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to the prompt, teacher, or source evidence.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and the paper's correctness metadata. Operation: Apply isolated code execution, topology checks, geometric validation, and export validation. Output and transition: Passing records form 999,633 executable CAD construction sequences stored as Parquet metadata plus CadQuery source, operation JSON, images, STL, and STEP assets. Check / stop rule: Reject failures; do not treat final-answer agreement as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The versioned release and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for CAD program generation SFT and agent training and compare with geometry-only CAD corpora and small executable-code datasets. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the controlled evidence reported by the paper. Check / stop rule: Pin data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, and harness; stop claims at the evaluated domains.

Reproducibility requires the official data revision, generation settings, verifier/tool versions, random seeds, split, base model, and evaluation harness. Unreported budgets remain unknown.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：由语言模型采样的机械零件描述，不依赖真实构造历史。 操作：统一题目、媒体、来源和参考字段，形成候选记录。 输出及流转：可审计候选进入目标生成阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少任务输入、来源标识或使用条款时拒绝。

步骤 2——写入可复用目标。 输入：标准化候选及其来源证据。 操作：工具代理生成构造代码、读取错误、查询文档并修复候选。 输出及流转：序列化回答、推理过程或工具轨迹进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：目标无法对应题目、生成者或来源证据时停止。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成目标和论文定义的正确性信息。 操作：执行隔离执行、拓扑检查、几何验证和导出验证。 输出及流转：通过的记录组成官方发布并按数据页格式保存。 检查与停止规则：失败记录被拒绝；最终答案一致不代表每个中间步骤正确。

步骤 4——训练并评估消费者。 输入：固定版本的数据与论文基础模型。 操作：用于CAD 程序生成监督微调与代理训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的消费者和论文报告的受控证据。 检查与停止规则：固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型和评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

复现还需固定数据版本、生成设置、验证器或工具版本、随机种子、切分、基础模型和评测器；未披露预算保持未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Experiment 1: All 999,633 released sequences pass code-execution, geometric, and export validation; the paper evaluates generation validity and diversity rather than treating rendering alone as success.

Experiment 2: The released artifact contains 999,633 executable CAD construction sequences; on 2026-07-27 the official Hub page exposed an actual record with fields uuid, CadQuery file, topology counts, operation sequence, latencies, eight renders, STL, and STEP files and reported 6985 downloads. Artifact use does not by itself validate the paper's causal claim.

实验 1：公开的 999633 条序列全部通过代码执行、几何和导出三层验证；论文另外评估生成有效性与多样性。

实验 2：官方发布规模为999633 条可执行 CAD 构造序列。2026-07-27 的数据页可读取含唯一编号、构造代码、拓扑统计、操作序列、耗时、八个渲染图以及两种几何文件的实际记录并显示 6985 次下载；使用量不能代替因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest prior baseline is geometry-only CAD corpora and small executable-code datasets. The paper changes the reusable object by making uuid, CadQuery file, topology counts, operation sequence, latencies, eight renders, STL, and STEP files explicit and coupling it to isolated code execution, topology checks, geometric validation, and export validation. This is a direction signal because another team can train the stated consumer from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是只含几何结果的 CAD 语料和小规模可执行代码数据集。真正变化是把唯一编号、构造代码、拓扑统计、操作序列、耗时、八个渲染图以及两种几何文件显式化，并与隔离执行、拓扑检查、几何验证和导出验证绑定。另一团队可以直接用公开记录训练所述消费者，因此这是数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. validator-passing geometry may be functionally meaningless.
  2. The published checks do not establish that every intermediate reasoning step is correct or causally necessary.
  3. Reuse must preserve Apache-2.0 and any upstream media or source-data terms.

1. 通过验证的几何体仍可能没有实际功能；合成零件描述也不足以代表真实设计约束。
  2. 已公开检查不能证明每个中间推理步骤都正确或不可替代。
  3. 复用必须保留官方许可，并继续遵守所有上游媒体或来源数据条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the dataset to build or ablate CAD program generation SFT and agent training; preserve provenance and compare a fixed backbone before attributing gains to the traces.
  • Audit a stratified sample against isolated code execution, topology checks, geometric validation, and export validation. The output should be a versioned keep/reject ledger, not only a benchmark score.

• 可用该数据构建或消融CAD 程序生成监督微调与代理训练；保留来源并固定骨干后，才能把收益归因于轨迹。
  • 按来源和难度分层抽样，依据隔离执行、拓扑检查、几何验证和导出验证复核。输出应是带版本的保留与拒绝台账，而不只是基准分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: Zero-to-CAD uses tool-using agents to synthesize, execute, repair, and validate nearly one million CadQuery construction programs without real trajectories.
  • Data object: uuid, CadQuery file, topology counts, operation sequence, latencies, eight renders, STL, and STEP files.
  • Author and selector: tool-using agents generate CadQuery code, inspect errors, consult documentation, and repair candidates; selection uses isolated code execution, topology checks, geometric validation, and export validation.
  • Evidence anchor: All 999,633 released sequences pass code-execution, geometric, and export validation; the paper evaluates generation validity and diversity rather than treating rendering alone as success.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for CAD program generation SFT and agent training; first audit validator-passing geometry may be functionally meaningless, and synthetic part descriptions underrepresent real designer constraints.
